$comment: The committed registry of the output screens (JRNY-07, plan 12-06). Both records CLICK THE REAL COMPUTE BUTTON rather than reading a seeded engine result: scripts/check-seed-fixture.mjs rejects a seeded output_json with the marker SEED WRITES OUTPUT -- 'a seeded engine result is a per-heir peso figure nothing computed' -- so the only honest way to reach a results view is to make the product compute one in the browser. Both declare reset case-alpha-no-output so each run starts from a wizard-phase case and computes fresh; a step that inherited the previous run's stored result would assert against a result nothing recomputed. settleMs is 4000, well above the registry's usual 1200, for a MEASURED reason: $caseId.tsx races compute() against a 30s timeout, FamilyTreeTab is a React.lazy chunk, AND the Recharts pie in DistributionSection animates for its 1500ms default -- browser.mjs's determinism stylesheet kills CSS animation but not a JS/rAF-driven SVG one. At settleMs 1500 the capture landed on the animation boundary and results-family-tree failed at diffPixels=147, every differing pixel on a pie-slice edge. Waiting longer is the correct fix; raising maxDiffPixels to paper over it is not, and REFERENCES.md does not permit it. NO RUBRIC HERE CARRIES A PESO FIGURE: money is asserted by gate G19 (plan 12-08) against a live recomputation, never by a committed expected figure.
